summary.intent: Coordinate several parallel subagents landing perf and fix work on the caliper repo (strip symbols #382, gitignored-file discovery #328, export alias naming #298), open PRs for them, then rein in subagents the user felt were consuming excessive tokens and running too long.
summary.outcome: Opened PRs #454 (strip release symbols, about -18% artifact size) and #455 (discovery/watcher agree on gitignored files), both BLOCKED only on pending Entire Gates. The #298 alias fix remained local because it breaks a pin in crates/semantic/tests/exports.rs. After the user complained about token use, agents were listed, some were stopped, and the remaining ones were messaged.

repo: Release builds now use strip = "symbols" in [profile.release]; [profile.bench] inherits it, so profiling needs CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=none or CARGO_PROFILE_BENCH_STRIP=none.

If the Rust toolchain's own bin/ is first on PATH, rust-objcopy aborts for missing libLLVM and the strip silently does nothing (napi stays about 32 MB). The default rustup PATH strips correctly. callisto-release.yml has no override, so first release artifact sizes should be confirmed.

Gitignored files were skipped by the directory walkers but not by is_source_file, so the watcher could treat ignored-file changes as source changes. Hidden files are kept by both, so the trail's hidden-file claim was inaccurate.
The #298 fix adds ComponentMapping::local_name, which makes it a core minor and a cache schema bump. Resolver and dts lookups still use the local binding, so typeof through the export resolves.
The repo's standard gate set is: just lint, doc-check, machete, typos, deny, semver, test-rust, test-checker-lane, test-ts, test-napi and test-integration.

code.finding: A single walk_builder configures both discovery and is_source_file. is_source_file walks only the directories down to the path so every ignore file on the way applies, and it does so after the exclude check.
Pins the component name CardImpl, so it fails once components are named by their export (Card). It needs updating, checked against ADR 0027.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user authority; verify claims such as 'pushed' with git ls-remote.
Subagents were told to stay out of crates/semantic while #449 was in flight, and that constraint blocked #298 until #449 merged.
Long-running subagents can burn tokens unnoticed; check ListAgents periodically and stop runaways.
PR descriptions should state what was and was not verified (for example, no timing taken, Linux/zig builds not tested, CI not checked).

friction: The #298 worker was blocked by the no-touch constraint on crates/semantic, and 2 tests failed in just test-rust.
The fixture diff for the #328 build was skipped and the oracle and tsrs construct lanes were never run on the #298 build.
The user was frustrated that subagents consumed excessive tokens and ran for a long time.
open_items: Finish and push #298 as its own branch: update the exports.rs pin to Card, confirm consistency with ADR 0027, check the oracle and weekly joins use exports not names, document the schema bump as a core minor with a Breaking/Action note, run the construct lanes and the fixture diff.
Check CI and Entire Gates for #454 and #455, which were BLOCKED on pending gates.
Confirm release artifact sizes on the first release after the strip change (Linux and zig builds unverified).
Still-running work: the accuracy-rows worker, the Storybook live-upgrade, S7b and the #451 merge.
After #451 merges, start the held work: F9, F11 and the JSDoc fix.
Check whether the CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP variable works on bench builds.
